reasoning_content: The realm name is not "urbo" but "swcode". Let me verify with the correct realm name.

action.command:
echo "=== Keycloak realm 'swcode' via proxy ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /realms/swcode: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET auth endpoint: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=urbo-frontend&redirect_uri=http://app.workspace.localhost"
echo "=== client list (urbo-frontend present?) ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-keycloak-1 bash -c 'KCTOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "client_id=security-admin-console" | head -c 50) ; echo "kc admin check skipped"' 2>/dev/null | head -2
docker exec urbo-workspace-keycloak-1 ls 2>/dev/null | head -3
